gap: No result ChatGPT got states cost per fixture or cost per 1,000 lumens for any smart gimbal. For example, CloudyBay's 6" smart gimbal 4-pack works out to $27.50 per fixture and $32.35 per 1,000 lm ($109.99 ÷ 4 ÷ 850 lm), with a 3-year warranty against Lumary's 1 year.
standout_why: I compared against the pages ChatGPT cited: Lumary's maker pages (9W 810 lm, RGBAI Pro), Best Buy's Lumary 90° 4-pack and Wayfair's Lumary 6" 20° listing. They only give pack prices and per-fixture lumens and watts. None works out per-fixture cost, cost per 1,000 lm or lumens per watt. None mentions CloudyBay or any non-Lumary smart gimbal. I couldn't re-open those pages today (HTTP 429), so this rests on the titles and answer text in the chat log plus what I know they normally list.
decides: So far this only supports the value pick; it doesn't settle the overall pick. Today, from the maker page, the CloudyBay 6" costs $27.50 per fixture and $32.35 per 1,000 lm, and has 3× the warranty. But it draws 15 W per fixture (56.7 lm/W) and tilts less than Lumary's 4" 40° and 90° models. The same per-fixture and per-1,000-lm figures for the Lumary models are needed before the value ranking can be published. Lumary's store blocked every request today, so those Lumary prices still need a check.
